CustomField.label: Operator
CustomField.description: Comparison operator. Narrowed to the five values PolicyRuleEvaluator can execute against the fields ReplayService actually selects (ADR-33 D-4 carve-out, 2026-08-02). NEQ and IN were removed because the evaluator's switch has no branch for them and throws PolicyEngineException at replay time. BETWEEN was removed because Policy_Rule__c has no Threshold_High__c, so the upper bound is always null and the rule silently never fires -- a wrong answer in an audit product, which is worse than a throw. Do not re-add any of the three without also widening Policy_Rule__c and the ReplayService SELECT/copy at lines ~84 and ~130.
